action: No security action is indicated. Workday customers: confirm that payroll runs, time entries and scheduled integrations from the evening of November 13 completed correctly.
exec: A payroll and HR supplier outage reportedly tied to backup-system testing; a reminder to have a fallback for time-critical pay runs.
plain: An outage on the evening of November 13 stopped many employees from signing in to Workday's payroll and staff-management service. HollywoodLife, citing the San Francisco Chronicle, reports a backup-testing problem; no attack is reported.
summary: A service disruption on the evening of November 13 locked users out of Workday's payroll and HR platform, with nearly 3,000 Downdetector reports shortly after 5 p.m. ET. Workday said it was working urgently to investigate and resolve it. HollywoodLife, citing the San Francisco Chronicle, reports a problem found during backup-system testing, and, citing People, restoration by about 11 a.m. ET Saturday.
title: Workday outage locks employees out of payroll and HR systems

validation.note: Read HollywoodLife (14 Nov): nearly 3,000 Downdetector reports after 5 p.m. ET Fri 13 Nov, Workday statement (investigating), cause per SF Chronicle, restoration ~11 a.m. ET Sat per People. CNN returns 451; Fox page only partly readable, so both removed from sources. Removed "gave no cause" (a cause was reported).
